messages:
sam: Hi everyone, new joiner here. Trying to provision a GCS bucket in europe-west2 for eval datasets but when I attempt to attach billing to my project it errors with 'billing account not visible'. Also our infra requires CMEK (KMS) keys and no external IPs. Can someone confirm what exact IAM roles I should request (billing + KMS + network) and whether IT needs the KMS key resource name?

cloudops-bot: Hello! To open a support ticket for billing/KMS access, use the internal form: https://redwood.internal/it/cloud-request. Include project_id, project_number, target_billing_account, kms_key_resource_id, and reason.

sam: Thanks — do I need roles/owner? I'd rather avoid that. Prefer least privilege for the project.

rachel: Welcome Sam :wave: You shouldn't need owner. For billing attach: Billing Account User (roles/billing.user) at the billing account + Project Billing Manager (roles/billing.projectManager) on the project. For CMEK access you need roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the key and roles/cloudkms.viewer for discovery. For creating buckets: roles/storage.admin. Since our projects are in a shared VPC, if you need to reserve subnets or set up VM endpoints ask for roles/compute.networkUser on the host project or Network Admin on the service project depending on the workflow.

sam: OK that helps. The KMS key resource id is projects/redwood-eu/locations/europe-west2/keyRings/eval-keyring/cryptoKeys/eval-key. Project number is 998877665. Target billing account is EU-BILL-002 (ID: 0612-3344-7788). Quota: just 4 vCPUs for a small preprocessing VM, no GPUs.

linda (IT): Thanks @sam, I'm taking this. Quick checklist for IT ticket: project_number, billing_account_id, kms_key_resource_id, exact role list (you listed them, good), and whether the project needs the Compute Engine default service account created. Also note about org policy: we will not grant external IPs. I will attach EU billing and add roles/storage.admin, roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter (bound to the key) and roles/iam.serviceAccountUser if you need to run ephemeral instances with service accounts.

sam: Please include roles/compute.networkUser on host project 'shared-vpc-host-eu' if that's needed to attach subnet. I can add the justification in the ticket.

cloudops-bot: New IT ticket created: #IT-8641 by sam - "Attach EU billing, KMS key bindings, storage + network perms for project 998877665". ETA 24-72h.

linda (IT): I see the ticket, I'll validate the key ARN and then apply roles. If you need this faster ping me here after you update the ticket with justification and the subnet name (we usually need projects/host/shared-vpc-host-eu/subnet/eu-subnet-1).

sam: Added the subnet name and justification. Thanks all, will wait for the update. :thumbsup:
